Feature: PCIe Device Enumeration and Link Training
Meta Test Description: This testcase performs PCIe device enumeration and link training. It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize. Depending on compile-time defines (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP), it invokes link_training_dm0_x4(4) or link_training_dm1_x4(4) for x4 link training. Cache programming is performed by reading mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, modifying bit fields [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22] using set_data(), and writing back. A wait_on(20) delay is inserted between cache programming phases. The SII0 register at offset 0xC0 is polled via read_sii0_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, indicating link-up status. Similarly, SII1 register at offset 0xC0 is polled via read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until the same condition is met. Under DM0_RC, the Vendor ID is read from pcie_slv0 offset 0x0 via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0), the command register at pcie_slv0 offset 0x4 is written with 0x7 via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4,0x7), and mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4() are called. Six system-level registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034 are written with 0x1. Cache disable programming follows by reading and modifying COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIE0 and PCIE1, setting fields [19:22] and [27:30] to 0x0. BAR registers at offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24 are probed on both pcie_slv1 and pcie_slv0 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF, reading back, then writing final address values and reading back again. Finally, register 0xE6004100 is polled until it reads 0x12345678, with wait_on(5) delays between iterations, then finish(0) is called.
Test Description: This test verifies PCIe device enumeration and link training. It initializes a control register, performs link training for x4 configuration, programs the COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF register for both PCIe controller 0 and controller 1 to enable cache coherency. It then polls SII link status registers until link-up is confirmed. Under root complex mode, it reads the device Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG, enables IO, memory, and bus master in TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG, and programs memory base addresses. System-level control registers are configured. Cache coherency is then disabled by clearing the relevant bit fields in COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. BAR sizing is performed on BAR0_REG through PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG by writing all-ones, reading back the size, then programming final BAR address values on both PCIe slave interfaces. The test concludes by polling a synchronization register until a completion pattern is received.
